sources.title: The hiyo story
sources.supported_claims: Launch May 2021 and name acronym happy in your own.
sources.limitations: Founder/brand intent, not measured consumer association.

sources.title: Inside Hiyo's 500K-case growth playbook with co-founder George Youmans
sources.publisher: Heritage Radio Network / Business of Drinks
sources.supported_claims: Founder reports over 500,000 cases annually; early DTC and retail expansion.
sources.limitations: Episode summary read; case size and exact reporting period absent. Founder report rather than scanner audit.

sources.title: Recess original Blackberry Chai
sources.supported_claims: Original range page still labels hemp and CBD, distinct from Mood.

sources.title: Katy Perry gets into the wellness game with De Soi
sources.supported_claims: Founder explains name from French maîtrise de soi.

sources.supported_claims: Company reports 10,000 US and 50,000 global distribution doors.
sources.limitations: Self-reported doors; beverage and supplement scope not reconciled; no sales-per-store data. Revenue forecast and funding not used as realized sales.

sources.title: TRIP CBD Infused Peach Ginger 250ml

sources.title: Daytrip prebiotic soda

sources.title: Daytrip organic yerba mate
sources.supported_claims: Separate caffeinated yerba-mate range and flavour names.
sources.limitations: Page includes Unavailable and Add controls; current fulfillment unresolved.

sources.title: Jack Scott and Alex Wright

sources.title: TÖST Beverages Inc. Form C-AR

sources.title: Seedlip Our Story
sources.supported_claims: Name derived from hand-sowing seed baskets; farming and distillation narrative.
sources.limitations: Brand-documented story; no evidence buyers understand obsolete term.

sources.title: Diageo acquires majority shareholding in Seedlip
sources.supported_claims: Majority acquisition; more than 25 countries and 7,500 venues/retailers in 2019.

sources.title: Non-alcoholic aperitif Botivo reveals how to create the ultimate alcohol-free cocktails
sources.supported_claims: Founder says botanical plus aperitivo; events origin and website-led sales in 2024.
sources.limitations: Direct founder account; no quantified commercial scale. Updated 2024-03-21.

sources.title: Meet the founders: Michael Sharon and Kalle Freese, Taika Coffee
sources.supported_claims: Founders explain Finnish taika means magic.
sources.limitations: Retailer-hosted founder interview; intent rather than consumer research.

sources.supported_claims: 2024 revenue CZK34m versus CZK13m in 2023; unification under PRAGER'S in 2025.
sources.limitations: Portfolio includes alcoholic cider and kombucha; cannot allocate revenue to nonalcoholic SKUs. CZK60m is a target, not achieved revenue.

sources.title: Aktin and Vilgain: one brand
sources.supported_claims: Current explanation of unification from Aktin to Vilgain across markets.

sources.title: CLUB-MATE history

sources.title: fritz-kola: über uns
sources.supported_claims: First cola 2003, further flavours 2004 and product-family expansion.
sources.limitations: Company chronology; longevity does not isolate name contribution.
